observations: Linear baseline on cleaned raw features. Train AUC 0.752 vs validation 0.735: small gap, so error is mostly bias.
Engineered ratios lift AUC by 0.012 (0.735 to 0.747); the linear model cannot build utilisation or delay-count features itself.
Balanced class weights raise AUC to 0.754 but F1 after threshold tuning is unchanged (0.522 vs 0.528): re-weighting mainly moves the operating point.
Train AUC 1.000 vs validation 0.757: the unpruned forest memorises the training set (high variance).
Same forest on raw features: 0.7575 vs 0.7567 with engineering. Feature engineering adds nothing for trees.
Leaf size 40, depth 16, sqrt features: +0.022 AUC over the default forest and train AUC falls to 0.854. Regularisation, not capacity, was the lever. Slowest run (297 s).
Default boosting already beats the tuned forest on F1 (0.547 vs 0.543) in 0.3 s, but train AUC 0.857 shows mild overfitting.
Eight leaves, learning rate 0.02, L2 = 10, early stopping: best traditional model by validation AUC (0.7806; CV 0.7887). Train AUC 0.807.
Dropping SEX, EDUCATION, MARRIAGE and AGE changes AUC by only 0.0002 and F1 by 0.002: demographics add almost no signal.
RBF SVM with C = 0.3: below logistic regression (0.721) despite a non-linear kernel.
C = 1: train AUC rises to 0.818 while validation falls to 0.719.
C = 3: train 0.844, validation 0.713. Larger C only increases overfitting; SVM is not competitive here.
Small MLP 64-32 on engineered features, no regularisation: 0.7795 already close to boosting.
Same network on raw features: 0.7717, 0.008 below D1. Engineering helps the network more than it helps trees.
Wider and deeper with dropout 0.3: 0.7810, +0.0015 over D1; more capacity brings little because signal is limited.
Batch normalisation: 0.7814, +0.0004 over D3, within seed noise (sd 0.0006).
Adding L2 1e-4 on top of dropout: 0.7803, no gain; dropout already regularises enough.
Learning rate 1e-2: best epoch 7, noisy validation loss, 0.7794. Fast but unstable.
Learning rate 1e-4: needs 126 epochs (36 s) to reach 0.7791, the same level as lr 1e-3.
Balanced class weights: 0.7791, lower AP (0.537); the weights shift scores, not ranking, so the threshold already compensates.
Functional API with a shared embedding of the six repayment statuses: 0.7797, no better than the plain MLP, because the ordinal codes are already informative.
256-128-64 with dropout 0.5 and batch size 128: 0.7803, close to the best configurations.
A single 64-unit hidden layer: 0.7761, slightly below the deeper networks.
Best network by validation AUC (0.7818): 256-128-64, dropout 0.5, batch norm, lr 3e-3. Reseeded runs average 0.7798, so part of this score is selection luck.
Single 64-unit layer with L2 1e-3 and batch norm: 0.7762, the same level as D11, so depth is worth about 0.004 AUC.
Learning rate 3e-4 needs 85 epochs; 0.7777, no better than lr 3e-3 runs of similar size.
Dropout 0.1 with L2 1e-3 and lr 3e-4: weakest network (0.7754); light dropout lets the 128-64 net fit noise.
Random search trial: 0.7807; 256-128-64 with batch norm and lr 3e-3 again near the top.
128-64 with lr 3e-3, batch 128: 0.7777, highest F1 among the late trials but lowest AP (0.533).
